notes.title: 1.0.7 Patch Update
notes.content:
Dear Folks,

Here is Minho Kim from Devespresso Games. This update will be the final Q2 update, which fixes the quest item slots on the right-bottom of GUI. It has some technical issues between save slots. We tested a lot to complete the patch, and finally here.

I hope this makes your game-playing much joyful.
Be healthy and safe. :)

Best Regards,

-Minho

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6a Scarlet Update
notes.content:
Dear folks of Glome,

:focused:
Finally we caught all bug criminals that have been occurred the unexpected loading crash and memory leak. Sorry for this long update, but we had to test a lot of it with many different OS and devices, with many different suspicions and researches. It's very difficult to find the bug which the devs cannot detect their devices, it randomly generated, and we don't know what was the main cause.

...It was like your stomach is suffering and the reason why is from your little finger. Doesn't make sense, right?

The dark age is gone, and the devs can rest now. So, please enjoy the world of Glome!

Best Regards,
Minho.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
Dear Folks,

Hi all! Thanks for your patience. We have been checking and working endlessly for the game, and here is a new patch. It's not completely perfect on the memory usage issue, but it will replace many of the game inside for 1) reducing the system work and 2) better graphic experience. 

The game would be much smoother, and loading is improved.
I hope you enjoy the game.

- Minho Kim.

notes.title: 1.0.4a patch
notes.content:
Dear All,

Hi, this is Minho from Devespresso Games. Here are the updates:

1. Spanish Update - Changed many issued lines and altered.
2. Ukrainian, Russian, and English update: Polished few lines in better way.
3. V-sync & FPS related patch: Our programmer believes this will make the game much lighter, and potentially prevent the loading crush issue more.

Cheers and thank you for playing the game!

Minho Kim
- Devespresso Games.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3s Hotfix Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38872802/a8b89dacad1efcd40482efb4fdfed94ff02063da.png[/img]

Howdy Folks,

We've discovered a number of bugs and have taken the appropriate steps to smash them!

1. Thai language: Seelie Temple clue pages have been updated. 
2. Puzzle: "Tuck's Caravan Wagon" we expanded the effective range for each tool since a lot of players were having trouble with this.
3. Double Ruby heel glitch in the Ruby Sanctum has been fixed.
4. Achievements 44, 45, and 46 can now be unlocked!

-Tristan

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Pivot Update
notes.content:
Hi all, thanks for playing the game. Through monitoring, we found many glitches and bugs, and we have been fixed almost day-by-day. The mainly remained bugs were two; loading freeze, and Scarlet's skin error.
We consider this patch will fix all!

1. European Language Update (Final): GER/FRN/RUS/UKR/SPA)
2. English Language Update - Polishing!
3. Scarlet's Skin error - Fixed
4. Loading Freeze #2 - 2nd patched. Fixed.
5. Graphic glitch is updated (Graveyard: 8 is not IIX! / Scarlet's eyes)

-Minho Kim

notes.title: 1.0.2 Oracle Patch
notes.content:
Dear all,

We have been checked many streaming broadcasts for this game (thanks for your playing), and we were able to figure what is the reason of the 'Loading Crash & Freeze'. The lead programmer worked hard to fix it, and I hope this is working for you.

I edited 'Vambrace' puzzle for your easier understanding. I hope that works too.
Also, 'Back to Ruby Shrine' event is also fixed for the designed flow.

Our next target is the Skin glitch, when you re-load the game. It will be fixed soon. Until then, enjoy Scarlet Hood!

- Minho & SP3CK
